overview: Call by value, reference (pointers), call by name, macros; swap examples, pointers to pointers.
coreConcept: C me sirf call-by-value; pointer pass karke reference jaisa effect.
hinglishExplanation: Function ko argument ki copy milti hai; pointer se original change ho sakta hai, par pointer khud copy hai (usko swap karne se caller par asar nahi). Call-by-name (macro jaisa) me expression textual substitute hota hai.
formalDefinition: C me sirf call-by-value; pointer pass karke reference jaisa effect.
importantProperties: Pointer swap local copy, caller pe asar nahi.
Pointer to pointer se pointer change hota hai.
Macro swap tmp variable clash/side effect.
